About

Right now I'm passionate about the energy sector, and about digital products more broadly. I'm a product manager at Carrier, working on the digital side of residential HVAC. I studied computer science with a business minor at UIUC, and I'm finishing a master's in marketing and strategy at Santa Clara University.

I'm especially interested in how insights from connected equipment, including firmware data, and machine learning can help reduce energy costs. For homeowners, that can mean a home that runs more efficiently. For technicians, it can mean clearer diagnostics and an easier service visit.

My work sits between engineering, analytics, and the people who use our products. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area and Atlanta. Open to on-site, hybrid, and remote roles.
